additional_info.subject: RE: ID0479399-DC/Si-D/AT- [Y2 / S5 313693895001] Signal Issue CRM:03289000599
additional_info.body:
Dear Laurenz,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0479399.
The ticket has been opened for error flag "Mainfan GQ1 - OK signal lost" on charger
Y2/S5 313693895001.
I checked in the logs, and the issue appeared for the first time on 2026-02-12, during a charging session, when the OK signal of the Mainfan was lost:
To solve this, it is necessary to conduct some troubleshooting onsite. Based on the following electrical scheme, it is necessary to check:
If the AC input is correctly arriving to the Fan
if the 24 volt of Signal OK is arriving to the fan.
If the 24 volt oof signal ok to plc is not interrupted in XD7
If the issue could be in the switch "status" inside the mainfan. In that case, it would be necessary to replace the main fan.
Because an onsite visit and troubleshooting is required, I will be moving this ticket
0479399
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-AT SI E Queue
.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-AT SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
If you need remote support for the onsite visit,
please reach out to me or my colleagues in advance before the day of the activity, so that we can confirm our availability.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com
www.siemens.com

Thank you.
